name: libc++abi
description: LLVM's implementation of low-level support for a standard C++ ABI, built together with libunwind as a standalone component against the already-installed LLVM/Clang 21.1.8. Uses LLVM's own unwinder (libunwind) rather than GCC's libgcc_s, since GCC is not present in the final system.
build: unset CXXFLAGS CFLAGS LDFLAGS; cmake -G Ninja -S llvm-project-21.1.8.src/runtimes -B llvm-project-21.1.8.src/runtimes/build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -D LLVM_ENABLE_RUNTIMES='libunwind;libcxx;libcxxabi' -D LLVM_DIR="$PREFIX/lib/cmake/llvm" -D LIBCXXABI_USE_LLVM_UNWINDER=ON -D LIBCXX_CXX_ABI=libcxxabi -D LIBCXX_HAS_MUSL_LIBC=ON -D CMAKE_C_COMPILER_WORKS=ON -D CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_WORKS=ON
unset CXXFLAGS CFLAGS LDFLAGS; ninja -C llvm-project-21.1.8.src/runtimes/build $MAKEOPTS
